name: MLS Co., Ltd
summary: MLS Co., Ltd. focuses on the entire process of LED technology, from its initial research and development to manufacturing and selling both LED components and finished lighting products. Their extensive product range includes various lighting solutions for different environments, such as industrial facilities, residential spaces, and general-purpose illumination. They also supply specialized LED elements like display diodes and modules, alongside power supply units and a wide selection of lighting fixtures. Established in 1997, the company's main operations are based in Zhongshan, China.
